prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight layout for pick friend screen: Redesign the friend selection screen using a spotlight layout to highlight individual pet choices and traits.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight"}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Photo example reference screen: Add a new preparation guide screen before photo upload showcasing good pet photo examples for best generation results.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_photo_reference", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_photo_reference": {"headline": "Photo Preparation Guide", "body": "Clear pet photos produce the best 3D desktop companion models.", "components": [{"type": "image", "label": "Sample Photo", "asset": "asset:photo_guide"}]}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pet care profile flow: Insert a short pet habit preference sub-flow before adoption certificate generation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_care_profile", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_care_profile": {"headline": "Set Pet Habits", "body": "Choose daily activity levels and interaction preferences.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Habits", "style": "playful"}]}}
3: [home, redesign] Stage layout for waiting screen: Rebuild the waiting screen with a stage layout and animated companion rendering progress view.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Bringing Your Pet to Life", "components": [{"type": "animation", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}]}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account recovery hint on sign in screen: Display explicit hint text explaining that signing in restores existing pets associated with the account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Use your existing email account to restore previously created desktop pets automatically."}}
5: [home, notification] Completion notification alert toggle: Enable desktop notification alerts on the waiting screen so users know when their pet finishes generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Get notified on desktop when your pet is fully prepared."}}
6: [finish, copy] Basic desktop pet interaction guide: Add clear helper text on the home intro screen detailing mouse clicks and shortcuts to hide or talk to the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Left-click to pet, right-click to hide or open settings, drag to move across desktop."}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Split layout for path selection screen: Change choose_path screen layout to split layout to visually present options clearly.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split"}}
8: [finish, new_screen] System tray menu quick summary screen: Add a new screen following home intro explaining how to manage desktop pet features from the system tray.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_tray_summary"], "new_tray_summary": {"headline": "System Tray Quick Access", "body": "Access controls and settings directly from your desktop system tray icon.", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Right-click tray icon anytime to manage your desktop companion.", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
9: [home, wait_info] Waiting progress and time display: Enable live time estimates and progress bar on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the pick_friend layout while keeping its core function is permitted.
Adding a new photo guide screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding a pet habit preference sub-flow during onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning the waiting screen layout while keeping its function is permitted.
Adding account recovery hint copy to the sign-in screen is allowed.
Enabling ready notifications on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed.
Updating interaction guidance text on the home intro screen is allowed.
Redesigning choose_path layout while retaining options is permitted.
Adding a new onboarding summary screen after home_intro is allowed.
Adding progress and time estimates to the waiting screen is permitted.
